evals.name: provider-names-only
evals.prompt: Model has an OpenId provider aliased Partner. Preview and production use different registrations. Where do the keys and values go?
evals.expected_output: Names-only inventory and explicit per-host resolution.
assertions: Keeps Partner in each clientId, clientSecret and authority requirement.
Keeps secret values out of model and source; supplies them through host secret bindings.
Distinguishes requirement discovery from testing provider connectivity.

evals.name: wrong-target
evals.prompt: All preview keys are present but the effective endpoint belongs to staging. Can startup proceed? Show the smallest offline check.
evals.expected_output: Validate the resolved target against a disposable allowlist before any I/O.
assertions: Refuses the wrong authority/resource rather than accepting an environment name.
Checks resolved endpoint including scheme and port without contacting staging.
Reports only the offending key; never prints credential-bearing URIs.

evals.name: missing-setting
evals.prompt: Design a local fixture showing that a missing service credential is detected safely, then show how to verify the positive case.
evals.expected_output: Exercise absent and provided credentials through an isolated provider without contacting a service.
assertions: Missing key fails before any connection attempt and no shared default is used.
Positive test injects a runtime-generated marker instead of committing a value.
Asserts intended target and absence of marker from success and failure output.
